// Loyalty: points per guest. 1 point is worth 1 cent when redeemed.
signal earn(guest: String, cash_amount: Int) -> Int   // Loyalty
    // Credits one point per full 100 cents of `cash_amount`. Returns the guest's points afterwards.
    requires cash_amount >= 0
writes     balance: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // guest -> points
               invariant balance >= 0
called by  Bookings.check_out
